ask: Move Tuesday's LinkedIn post to Thursday at 2pm.
before: list-scheduled-posts showed the post: Tue Nov 17, 9:07 am (New York), LinkedIn, "Most hiring advice…". The reply asked "Move it to Thu Nov 19, 2:00 pm (New York)?" and the user said yes.

steps.why: Only post_id and scheduled_time: update-post takes no workspace_id, and no status, text, media or accounts here. A time-only move keeps the post Scheduled with its approval and any client sign-off; the approval moves to the new slot. Wall clock in the brand's time zone, no Z, no offset; add timezone only if the user named a place. The new time must be in the future.
Read back the status and time Bolta stored, if the update result didn't show them.

say: Moved for Acme: LinkedIn "Most hiring advice…" now goes out Thu Nov 19, 2:00 pm (New York). It keeps its approval.
never: Pulling the post back to Draft just to change its time: that sends it back for a new yes.
Changing the text in the same call: any edit to text, media or accounts needs a new yes.
Moving it before the user saw the new time and said yes.
Using schedule-post to move a post that is already Scheduled: with review mode on it sends the post back to the review list. update-post with only the time is the move.
